name: What are the pros and cons of installing a touchless kitchen faucet?

mainEntity.name: What are the pros and cons of installing a touchless kitchen faucet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Touchless faucets provide exceptional convenience, improved kitchen hygiene, and help keep fixture handles clean when cooking. However, they introduce added maintenance considerations compared to standard mechanical fixtures. Touchless units rely on batteries or an under-sink AC power outlet, which may require adding electrical wiring during your kitchen renovation. They also use solenoid valves that can be sensitive to hard water deposits, making reliable shutoff valves and proper filter maintenance important considerations for long-term operation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Touchless faucets improve cleanliness and ease of use, but they require a power source and contain solenoid valves that need occasional maintenance.
